reliable_gain: Check exact penalty/normalization and source attribution against the requested belief-functional text and primary KL equations.
exploratory_gain: Identify which part of a belief functional remains visible to value evaluation and what rational arithmetic can soundly certify without pretending to implement logarithms.
planned_lanes: Approximately 60% R / 40% X; source work remains the main task; no source-count target beyond existing scope.
scope: F03 continuation only. Resolve inspection gaps and exact candidate/source bridges; package a checkpoint, leave partial if L60 or substantive criteria unmet. No F04 or Gate A.
failure_test: A claimed belief/value equivalence must survive normalization, support restrictions, optimization order, and an explicit nonconvex counterexample.
